dict.string: A coding agent or terminal running in Clash of Claudes wants to read files in your Downloads folder. Clash of Claudes itself never reads it; you can safely say no.
A coding agent or terminal running in Clash of Claudes wants to read files on your Desktop. Allow it if a workspace lives there; otherwise you can safely say no.
Clash of Claudes creates new project folders in Documents/.clashofclaudes, and coding agents running in it work in your workspaces there. Allow it, or new folders and agents in Documents won't work.
A coding agent or terminal running in Clash of Claudes wants to read files on a removable drive. Allow it if a workspace lives there.
A coding agent or terminal running in Clash of Claudes wants to read files on a network drive. Allow it if a workspace lives there.
